issues.summary: Irregular-sampling claims untested: drop_prob hard-wired to 0 (trainer.py:290), base_dt hard-coded 0.1 (autoencoder.py:404); QG data dt is 0.05.
issues.resolution: dt and drop_prob are now config values (tests: test_claim01_rollout_uses_configured_dt). Irregular-dt training is genuinely supported only by the new CT-KAE (stride augmentation).

issues.summary: forward() requires CUDA (CUDA events, 4x torch.cuda.synchronize); cannot run on CPU, host blocks every call.
gt_longer_1000.nc and gt_*_subsample_1.nc label t spacing 0.1 but frames are 0.05 apart.
Rollout starts from (history+present)/2 encoding but latent targets use present-only encoding.
issues.resolution: training.consistent_latent_targets (test_enc01); the new CT-KAE uses consistent stop-grad targets by construction

issues.summary: Prediction loss always squared regardless of loss_type; gradient weight capped at 3 (comment says 10).
Second-difference smoothness penalty on non-detached encoder outputs biases against oscillatory latents; energy term weighted 0.0; FFT phase term duplicates MSE.

Continuous eigen mode raises AssertionError; qg_eval.py TypeError; register_models.build_kae passes is_continuous=cfg.model; decoder expansion_map unused (14k params); re_predictor untrained when re_weight is null.
issues.resolution: continuous eigen mode now raises NotImplementedError at construction (test_dead01). qg_eval.py and build_kae left as is: QG is blocked by DATA-01.

issues.summary: evaluate.py swallows exceptions; load_checkpoint returns an untrained model with a warning if the file is missing.
Single RK4 step vs exp(dtA): ||P4-exp|| = 1.6e-4 (TRA), 6.5e-8 (KS), 3.3e-7 (QG); max|lambda|dt <= 0.36. Not a practical error source at dt=0.1.
No latent collapse: |z| ~ 10 throughout rollouts. Checkpoint round trip exact; eval deterministic. TRA/KS splits leak-free in time.

Saved KAE prediction files (autoreg_pde_diffusion/src/results/sampling/*/continous_linear_128_tra.npz, Aug 24) cannot be reproduced from any checkpoint with the repository code; the step-1 prediction of the closest checkpoint (run-20260821 epoch_199, same weights as final_model.pth, same config) differs by 0.07 (fp32 and TF32 alike). The model code was changed in a5f4796 after the evaluation.
